messages:
Sophia Chen: Heads-up — need to swap my oncall for Sun 3/28 08:00–20:00 PST. Flight got rebooked, can't make morning. I can cover Sat 3/27 18:00–23:59 instead.
Samir Patel: I can take the 3/28 day if that's still open. Quick Q: any ongoing risks I should be aware of?
Sophia Chen: Thanks Samir :raised_hands: — main things:
- Rolling deploy to dedicated-gpu pool tonight at 22:30 PST (watch for increased error 502s for a few minutes)
- Elevated eviction rate on g4dn-16xlarge for infra-123 (auto-recovering but could drop capacity)
- Cache pressure on embed-cache (misses up from 0.6% -> 1.8% last 6h)
Playbook excerpt:
```
# quick checks
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-serving
curl -sS https://status.internal.redwood/api/health | jq .summary
redis-cli -h embed-cache-01 info | grep used_memory
```
If the rolling deploy causes 502 spikes, switch traffic to fallback model `rwd-small-2` (see console > rollouts)
Matt Nguyen: note for routing — if dedicated pool goes below 60% capacity, alerting will hit oncall-sre and oncall-infra. Samir, tag me if you need escalation to infra.
Lia Gomez: FYI, function-calls feature flagged in staging will be toggled in prod tomorrow morning; it's not on the 3/28 timeline but worth watching logs for schema errors.
oncall-bot: schedule change pending: @Samir Patel assigned 2027-03-28 08:00-20:00 PST (awaiting confirmation)
Samir Patel: Confirmed, I'll take 3/28. I'll ping here if anything noisy in first hour. Thanks Sophia.
Sophia Chen: Perfect — I'll update my calendar and add the handoff checklist link: https://wiki.redwood/team/oncall/handbook#sophia-handoff
Sophia Chen: Small note: if you get persistent 502s during the deploy, restart `rwd-proxy` on worker nodes 3..5, then file a short ticket and ping #eng-oncall. :airplane:
Matt Nguyen: :thumbsup: Logged on my side. Good luck with the flight.
oncall-bot: schedule updated: @Samir Patel assigned. :white_check_mark:
